name: 33407 · West Palm Bch, FL
findings: ZIP 33407 (West Palm Bch) has 224 nonprofit organizations. 80 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33407 (West Palm Bch) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33407 (West Palm Bch) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).
